description:
The Asmaraty G-77 is a brand-new 78ft (23.7 m) flybridge yacht built in the United Arab Emirates. We went on board at the Qatar Boat Show 2026 and obtained an exclusive price with an exceptional promotion, available through Yacht Research.

The main deck combines a saloon with a large curved sofa and a formal dining area under wide side windows, in a warm oak and cream interior. The helm station sits forward with a classic wooden wheel and modern displays. Up top, the flybridge is a real gathering point with a U-shaped lounge, a bar, sunbeds and a second helm, with space for an optional hot tub; the foredeck adds a large sunbathing area.

Below, four guest cabins sleep eight: the owner's cabin with a double bed, en-suite bathroom and walk-in wardrobe, a forward VIP cabin with generous storage, and two twin cabins on the sides. The crew quarters sleep three, with their own galley area and bathroom.

She is offered with a choice of twin engines from 600 to 1,200 hp, a 28 kVA generator and chilled water air conditioning, and her hydraulic swim platform comes as standard. Her very shallow draft of 1.06 m gives access to anchorages most yachts of her size cannot reach.

Contact Yacht Research for the full specification, the engine options, delivery timing and a private viewing.
